messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？" They want the entropy change for 1 kg of ice from 0°C to 100°C at 1 atm. We need to calculate ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For heating ice from 0°C to 0°C (phase change) we need latent heat of fusion at 0°C: L_f = 334 kJ/kg. Then heating water from 0°C to 100°C: use specific heat capacity of water c_water = 4.18 kJ/(kg·K). For heating ice from 0°C to 0°C? Actually initial temperature is 0°C, so no heating of ice. So only two processes: melting at 0°C (latent heat) and heating water from 0°C to 100°C. For melting at constant temperature T=273.15 K, ΔS_fusion = m * L_f / T. For heating water from 0°C to 100°C, ΔS_heating = m * c_water * ln(T_final/T_initial). T_initial = 273.15 K, T_final = 373.15 K. So compute: m=1 kg. L_f=334 kJ/kg = 334000 J/kg. T=273.15 K. So ΔS_fusion = 334000 / 273.15 ≈ 1222.5 J/K. Next ΔS_heating = 4180 J/(kg·K) * ln(373.15/273.15). ln(373.15/273.15)=ln(1.366)=0.312. So ΔS_heating = 4180 * 0.312 ≈ 1305 J/K. Total ΔS = 1222.5 + 1305 ≈ 2527.5 J/K. The user asked for "焦耳/開氏度" which is J/K. So answer ~2528 J/K. Provide explanation.
